units.source_text: 中学生都惮憬的短剑，确实是很美的装饰。

en.t: The short sword that every middle school student longed for was indeed a very beautiful ornament.

units.source_text: 听说海军学校的学生偷用这把短剑削过铅笔。

en.t: I heard that students at the naval academy had secretly used this short sword to sharpen pencils.

units.source_text: 故意让这样在严的象征派上日常琐碎生活的用场，真够气派啊。

en.t: Deliberately putting such a solemn symbol to use in the trivial routines of daily life was truly stylish.
